source_text: A torrente Arnon usque ad Hermon — termini victoriae. Latitudo regni Christi ab humilibus ad alta.
pass_a_gloss: From brook Arnon as-far-as unto Hermon — boundaries of-victory. Breadth of-kingdom of-Christ from low-things unto high.
pass_b_english: From the Arnon torrent to Hermon — victory’s bounds. Christ’s kingdom stretches from low things to high.
